invariants: Every return is solved as the first longitude root inside an explicit TT search window.
Solar Return uses the Sun, Lunar Return uses the Moon, and Planetary Return accepts an explicit requested body.
The solver uses the supplied versioned EphemerisProvider and rejects body, TT instant, source or data-version mismatches.
The plus/minus 180-degree signed-angle branch cut cannot be mistaken for a longitude-return root.
Search windows outside packaged ephemeris coverage fail closed and no device clock or network fallback is used.
No return is fabricated when the supplied window contains no root.
